subject: SIG attachment request — intrusion assessment & evidence mapping for GRC upload
body:
From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@gatewayhealth.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: GRC Uploads <grc-uploads@gatewayhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SIG artifact request: intrusion test report and mapping

Hi Rachel / Vanessa,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's deployment last week. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review we need the penetration/intrusion assessment report and a simple evidence index that maps findings to the SIG control set. Gateway requires:

- The final pen test report (redacted where necessary)
- A CSV index with artifact filenames, control IDs (SIG v2025 mapping), and remediation status
- Confirmation that any PII referenced has been redacted or removed from the upload

Can you confirm whether you can:
1) Upload the redacted report(s) to our GRC portal link (see CC'ed grc-uploads address), or provide a secure share link?
2) Provide the CSV evidence-index described above?
3) Share a short remediation summary for high findings (CVSS >=7) with expected completion ETA?

We need the artifacts by EOD next Wednesday to stay on our procurement schedule. Happy to hop on a quick 20-min sync if that's easier.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Security Program Manager — Gateway Health

-----

From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@gatewayhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG artifact request: intrusion test report and mapping

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list.

Short answers up front: yes, we can upload redacted report(s) to your GRC upload endpoint; we will attach the evidence index CSV; and we'll include a remediation-summary for any high findings.

Plan:
- I'll coordinate redaction and confirm what must be blacked out (PII / client-specific data).
- Vanessa will prepare the evidence-index CSV showing file -> SIG control mappings and remediation status.
- Marcus will draft the remediation summary for HV findings and provide ETAs.

If you can confirm the exact control version (SIG v2025 vs SIG v2026) that Gateway wants mapped, we'll align. Otherwise we'll map to SIG v2025 by default and include a column that lists the SIG control ID.

ETA: we'll aim to have the upload + index by Tuesday EOD PT (2026-08-17). If something slips, we'll notify you immediately.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none on this message

-----

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@gatewayhealth.com>, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG artifact request: intrusion test report and mapping

Hi Samantha — looping in the artifacts team.

We have the final intrusion assessment from 2026-07-29. The report contains a handful of screenshots and network details that reference customer names; we'll redact those fields and generate two deliverables: the redacted PDF and an evidence-index CSV. The CSV will include columns: artifact_filename, artifact_type, sig_control_id, affected_component, remediation_status, remediation_eta.

Quick question on scope: do you want us to include both the full test appendices (large packet captures / pcap references) or just the report appendices and sampling artifacts? We can upload the PCAP metadata in the CSV but not the raw PCAPs unless requested and a secure transfer is arranged.

For tracking, I'll upload the two primary artifacts and add a note referencing each mapped SIG control in your GRC record. Upload will be to: https://grc.gatewayhealth.com/uploads/record/9F3B2 (CC'ing their mailbox for ingestion).

-Vanessa Ortiz
Principal InfoSec Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-index-template.csv (stub)

-----

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@gatewayhealth.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG artifact request: intrusion test report and mapping

Samantha,

Following up on remediation status for high-severity findings: we have three open high findings from the July assessment. Short status:

1) Privilege escalation via legacy admin endpoint — patch scheduled and staged; fix deployed to prod canaries 2026-08-18; full rollout 2026-08-22; residual monitoring in place.
2) Misconfigured S3 ACL exposing logs — ACL corrected 2026-08-05; audit confirms no external reads; incident closed.
3) Outdated library (crypto dependency) with low exploitability but elevated CVSS score — scheduled upgrade in the 2026-08-20 maintenance window; mitigation via WAF rules already applied.

I'll include these as the remediation_summary in the evidence-index CSV and attach the ETA dates. Let us know if you want a short recorded walkthrough for the fixes.

Marcus Lin
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments to follow: remediation-summary.md (stub)

-----

From: GRC Uploads <grc-uploads@gatewayhealth.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@gatewayhealth.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG artifact request: intrusion test report and mapping

Hello Redwood team — upload received and processed. Thank you for the quick turnaround. We ingested the following items to record 9F3B2:

- 2026-07-intrusion-assessment-summary-redacted.pdf (status: accepted)
- evidence-index-2026-07.csv (status: accepted)
- remediation-summary.md (linked in evidence-index)

Next steps for procurement: our risk team will review the mapping to SIG v2025 controls and either mark items as accepted or request clarifications. We may follow up with a request for the sample PCAP metadata if we need to validate a specific finding.

Samantha will be in touch if anything else is needed.

Best,
GRC Uploads (automated) — Gateway Health

Attachment: upload-log-9F3B2.txt (stub)
